notes: v1 (P=A): P repeats one look across all four: a violet/lavender pill with a white sheen sweep and a blurred purple halo, on pale lavender pages, differing mainly in page context and a curve picker. Q has more range in palette (cream on navy, violet on indigo, cream and teal glaze backdrop) and in motion ideas (lift-curve settings, rebound versus symmetric drift, a state showcase), though Q1 to Q3 still share a dark-hero-with-pill composition.

v2 (P=B): P repeats one hover mechanism (radial glow behind the button, translateY lift, blurred tail, same ease family) across four pages whose hero and button structure nearly match, with P3 and P4 especially alike (dark navy hero, cream primary button, tuning controls). Q varies the motion vocabulary more (sheen sweep, spin, bump, drifting motes, aura and ring pulses, press-state specimens) and the palettes (violet/rose on pastel, mint/sky, dark navy on lavender), though Q2 and Q3 share the Lumen name, pastel blobs and violet-rose gradient, and the sheen sweep recurs in all four.

v3 (P=A): P1 and P2 share the same violet-to-pink gradient and glow on hover, while P3 (navy, sheen ring) and P4 (motes, curve lab) use different mechanisms and page contexts. In Q, all four pages reuse one blur-tail face/trail engine with near-identical cubic-bezier families, and the button colour is mostly the same violet or navy, so the four read as one design with different skins.

v1 (P=A): P is four framings of one cloud type (nacreous/pearl clouds at dusk), all leaning on the same rare-and-unseen idea, though the lines and moments differ somewhat. Q is three near-identical poems about a lenticular cloud holding over a ridge in midwinter wind (Q1, Q2, Q4 share lines and images), with only Q3 offering a different take (a dusk veil with a shell sheen).

v2 (P=B): P is one lenticular-cloud-over-ridge-in-wind picture written three times (P2, P3, P4 share lens, ridge, midwinter wind and hold/still), with only P1's shell-sheen dusk breaking off. Q is one nacreous/pearl cloud at dusk in all four, with P1 and P2 both leaning on pearl and unseen, but the angles differ more (edge of night and being unseen, rarity, expectation, passing before it is named).

v3 (P=A): Set P is one subject (nacreous pearl clouds) from four angles: rarity, an unseen observer, ephemerality, and surprise, though P1 and P4 share a winter-dusk frame. Set Q is three near-identical lenticular-over-ridge poems (Q1, Q3, Q4 all use midwinter, wind, lens, ridge), with only Q2 (dusk veil, shell sheen) offering a different take.

v1 (P=A): P keeps every design in the bottom-right corner, dark, with a collapsed one-line bar and a package list plus add-package form; the open states differ mainly in list chrome (tabs, pills, timeline). Q varies placement (Q3 sits top-right, the rest bottom-right) and uses a single-parcel stepper in most, though Q2 and Q4 repeat the same toast-plus-controls structure.

v2 (P=B): P1, P2 and P3 repeat one design: a collapsed bar that expands to a vertical five-stage timeline of a single parcel, dark neutral palette, and only the placement (top-right vs bottom-right) and footer differ; P4 is the only real departure, a multi-package list. Q varies more: Q1 is a package-management panel with an add form, Q2 a per-package timeline list, Q3 stacked package cards in a pill, and Q4 a segmented All/Active/Delivered panel with a horizontal dot stepper and mint accent, though Q1 and Q2 share a bottom-right pill-and-list pattern.

v3 (P=A): P1, P2 and P4 are close relatives: bottom-right dark card or pill that expands into a multi-package list with per-row progress, timeline and Next/Remove actions, and P2 and P4 are nearly the same pill-to-list pattern; only P3 (All/Active/Delivered tabs, horizontal stepper, teal accent) departs. Q varies more in placement (Q2 sits top-right, the rest bottom-right) and in information structure (single-parcel timeline with Show history in Q3, Keep open in Q4, a page-list plus vertical timeline in Q2), though Q1 and Q3 repeat the same bottom-right 'Handed to the carrier 3 of 5' pill and timeline.
